Notes

Le Feu
 was published in Paris in 1916.
We have used the English translation of 1917 here.
Some of the British words used will probably need
translation as well.
A few missing quotation marks have been replaced;
the em dash is rendered as two minus signs without
space on either side.  We have not preserved the
page numbers.

The book is rather long to read online.  If your
time is limited you may wish to skip to chapter 20
and read from there.  The first chapter and last
give much of the tone of Barbusse's perspective
on the war.  The year he died, Barbusse published 
a book on Stalin.  

For more online information about World War I,
please see the excellent web site, 

www.worldwar1.com
